method.outcome: Near post minus near pre multiplied by comparison post/pre, divided by reported project cost in $M
method.sentiment: Whole-review VADER plus provisional clause-level target-aware keyword rules
method.polarity_unit: negative fraction of reviews with nonempty text; topic negative counts require an area target
method.business_balanced: Equal mean of each reviewed business text rate; business_reporting_share counts businesses with at least one mention. Excludes missing text.
method.feature_timing: Only predefined baseline years enter prediction features; construction timing may overlap
method.identity: Reviews scored once by review ID; shared project memberships aggregated separately

limitations: Yelp reviewers are not a representative resident sample.
Lexical targets and polarity can be wrong; empirical label accuracy not established.
Review volume is not revenue, economic return, or causal benefit.
Text enrichment adds features, not independent project outcomes.
